# Contract, History and Security Checklist: ADO Simulator API

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of contract fidelity with ADO, history completeness and concurrency, and security (tokens, authentication, no secrets, separation from the platform) before Gate 2
**Created**: 2026-11-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Contract fidelity: completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is every operation the simulator serves listed with the ADO reference page it follows, and does the list cover what features 016–018 will need (find changed items, read history, link, comment, resolve identities)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, contracts/operations.md]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the known-differences list required to name each divergence already identified (identities on the simulator's own host, no revision limit, `bypassRules` refused, `/health` and `/openapi.json`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, §FR-022, research R-02]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the handling of a missing or unsupported `api-version` specified for every operation? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it specified how feature 016 consumes the fixtures (location, how a fixture change is versioned, what counts as a breaking change)? [Dependency, Gap, Spec §FR-021]

## Contract fidelity: clarity and consistency

- [ ] CHK005 Do spec Clarification Q3, FR-022 and research R-01 state the same contract source after the change from a vendored specification to one written from the reference? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK006 Is a status code and error body specified for every refusal (failed `test /rev`, invalid field or state, unknown item, unauthenticated, unsupported operation), and are the codes the reference does not state marked as assumptions to confirm against real ADO? [Clarity, Assumption, Spec §FR-004, research R-02]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the `errorPolicy` behaviour (`Fail` versus `Omit`) for missing ids in list and batch reads stated precisely, rather than "as ADO does"? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the behaviour beyond each limit specified (more than 200 ids in a batch, more than 20,000 query results, comment and update paging), not only the limit itself? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the WIQL subset defined precisely enough that, for any query, it is decidable whether it is inside the subset or must be refused? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011, contracts/wiql.md]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the board model (columns are the Epic's states, sub-stage in `Custom.AdlcSubStage`) consistent between the spec, SA §22.3's Option A board model and the seed file contract? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it stated consistently (FR-005, FR-006, the seed contract) that the simulator enforces no allowed values or transitions for the decision field or states beyond the type's state list? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the fixture matching rules (which response parts are matched by value and which by type, such as ids and times) defined so a fixture's pass or fail is objective? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, research R-11]

## History completeness

- [ ] CHK013 Is "nothing lost between reads" defined as a reader protocol (inclusive changed-date bound, de-duplication by id and revision) rather than only as an outcome? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, research R-06]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the content of an update fully specified for relation changes, including that both linked items record the change? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "a patch that changes nothing creates no revision" consistent with "every change produces exactly one update"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the precision and source of `System.ChangedDate` specified, including what happens if the host clock moves backwards? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, research R-06]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the reset requirement reconciled with the append-only rule for updates and revisions (reset removes them; nothing else may)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-019, data-model]

## Concurrency and recovery

- [ ] CHK018 Is atomicity required for a link change that touches two items (both get a new revision and update, or neither)? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK019 Are concurrency requirements defined beyond conflicting updates of one item, for example a link added while the target item is updated, or two creations at once? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Are durability requirements defined for an interrupted write (a crash mid-change), not only a clean restart? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the SC-002 scenario (reader interval, number of identities, change mix) specified tightly enough to be reproduced? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK022 Is "on the demo host" in SC-004 defined well enough (machine, data set, warm or cold start) for the 1-second target to be checked consistently? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]

## Security: authentication and tokens

- [ ] CHK023 Do the requirements state, for every operation, whether authentication is required, with the exceptions (health, the contract document) listed explicitly? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, §FR-024, contracts/operations.md]
- [ ] CHK024 Are token format, entropy and the hashing key requirements (minimum length, what happens to existing tokens if the key changes) specified? [Completeness, Gap, research R-09]
- [ ] CHK025 Is token expiry deliberately excluded (and recorded as an assumption), or is it a missing requirement? [Gap, Assumption, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK026 Is it specified who may run the operator commands (token issue and revoke, reset) and where their output goes? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-015, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK027 Is "a refusal never reveals whether an identity exists" stated so it can be checked objectively (same status and body for an unknown, revoked or wrong token)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-015]

## Security: secrets, data and exposure

- [ ] CHK028 Do the log requirements cover every log source, including errors and tracebacks, so no field value, comment text or token can appear? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024, §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the requirement that the seed file and fixtures hold no secrets stated in a way that can be checked automatically? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017, §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the threat model documented: who can reach the simulator, on which network, and the accepted risk that any authenticated identity can change any item? [Assumption, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK031 Are input size limits specified (field text, comment text, patch size, query length) so the simulator cannot be exhausted by one request? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the requirement handed to features 017 and 018 that stored text and HTML are untrusted (never rendered as markup) recorded where those features will find it? [Dependency, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Separation from the platform

- [ ] CHK033 Are the separation requirements (no `ADLC_*` setting, no platform data or specs, imports forbidden in both directions) consistent between FR-023, SC-008, constitution VII (1.2.0 proposed) and the plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the dependency of this feature on the proposed constitution 1.2.0 and SA §22 update (both pending approval) recorded, with what happens if they are not approved? [Dependency, Assumption]

## Notes

- Items are open for the reviewer at Gate 2; the author did not mark any.
- `/speckit-implement` reads the checklist state but does not change the markers.
- Items found to be real gaps are fixed in the spec or plan before `/speckit-tasks`.
